ValidationRule.description: Complete is the status that lets an order go untaxed, so it cannot be set without the parts that make a 51A126 a certificate: the exemption number, the purchaser, who signed it and when.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Complete"), OR( ISBLANK(Exemption_Id__c), ISBLANK(Organization_Name__c), ISPICKVAL(Organization_Type__c, ""), ISBLANK(Signer_Name__c), ISBLANK(Signature__c), ISBLANK(Signed_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A Complete certificate needs an exemption ID, organization name, organization type, signer name, signature and signed date. Leave it Pending until you have all six.
